fabrics.name: Network
fabrics.definition: Connectivity as a service — core, edge, subsea, satellite integration, network APIs, SDN/NFV, private networks, optical and photonic transport.
fabrics.open_question: Refine definition and included offerings with TCL stakeholders.

fabrics.name: Cloud
fabrics.definition: Cloud, hosting and security — multi-cloud connect, edge compute, SASE/zero-trust, sovereign cloud, cloud-delivered security.
fabrics.open_question: Refine definition and included offerings with TCL stakeholders.

fabrics.name: Interaction
fabrics.definition: How enterprises and their customers communicate — CPaaS, contact centre, conversational AI, video, messaging, collaboration.
fabrics.open_question: Refine definition and included offerings with TCL stakeholders.

fabrics.name: IoT
fabrics.definition: Connected things and the intelligence on them — connectivity management, industrial IoT, telemetry platforms, edge AI on devices.
fabrics.open_question: Refine definition and included offerings with TCL stakeholders.

note: A technology can touch several fabrics; it is assessed separately in each. Security and AI cross-cut all four — a cross-cutting technology is assessed in the fabric where its buyer sits.
